# Nihang representation and performance

Resume the isolated leader, rearing and crowd passage with one-second handles.
The outcome remains a believable, powerful exchange in the same illustrated
film as the accepted Pashtun. Neither a new controller nor a diagnostic render
is that outcome. Existing 320 and 331 candidates remain rejected.

## First proof and method

The first internal work package inspects the horse's actual deformation and
control ownership. Its 64 invalid armature drivers and historical FK bypasses
make another root-pivot and quaternion-offset pass an unsupported choice.
Read rest and evaluated joints, constraints, driver target paths and mesh
bindings without changing the source. Compare the recorded pose with the
reference's gather, drive, crest, reach/contact and absorption phases. Then
choose targeted control repair or a replacement deformation representation
from evidence. Do not silently delete broken dependencies to clear a gate.

The reference video is faithful performance authority, not merely inspiration.
The accepted Pashtun is the same-film surface and supporting-character quality
control, not an instruction to copy her identity. Failed 320/331 frames are
negative controls only. Preserve their original files and findings.

## Integrated path

1. Establish control ownership and a discriminating whole-pose control.
2. Prove coupled hindquarter loading, chest lift, articulated neck and poll,
   folded forelegs, reaching landing and compression with supported hind feet.
   Check rider seat, hands, reins and stirrups in intended, side and rear views.
3. Prove one leader and one near crowd actor: recognizable turban construction,
   credible garment volume and folds, face, beard and tack at shot framing.
   Do not replicate a schematic or failed actor.
4. Animate the continuous action with fast powerful impact, a brief crest,
   coordinated rider response and persistent ground effects. Crowd members
   preserve attention on the rider while turning and stepping with varied,
   motivated timing. They must not slide sideways in synchronization.
5. Render only the contiguous leader/crowd passage, frames252–441 at24fps,
   including one-second handles; review all claimed interfaces and frames.
   Queue one complete clip for Director audiovisual judgment only after
   source/frame-visible blockers are resolved. No fabricated AV pass.

## Boundaries and reassessment

Use existing local Blender, serial heavy jobs, reversible derivatives and
source-bound typed handlers. New handlers require tests and native controls.
No provider calls, paid model trials, new assets, installations, remote compute,
uploads or additional artistic identity choices. Do not rerender Pashtun or
change the Sikh principal, full edit or music. The previous331 initial plus two
failed corrections remain closed;335 changes representation, not the label on
the same method. Keep correction accounting cumulative within this package.

Stop propagating a failed prerequisite. Replan the affected stage when control
ownership, support, whole-pose anatomy or same-film appearance fails; routine
technical diagnosis is not a Director handover. Carry all failures forward.
Completion requires the integrated isolated clip and honest evidence; escalate
only a genuine material choice or exhausted viable authorized method.

# Production proof331 — failed early proof, not a review-ready clip

## Outcome and evidence boundary

The initial native pose trial and two corrective variants did not qualify the
Nihang horse/rider pose family or supporting-cast appearance. No crowd replication,
continuous clip, final sound mix or Director audiovisual queue was produced.
The accepted Pashtun253 master and rejected320 source were not edited.

This is a negative production result. It is not evidence that agent-only animation
is impossible, that the source horse rig is incapable, or that another model would
solve it. Native inspection showed usable controls; their coordinated use remains
unqualified. A narrower, useful finding is that root-pivot/joint-angle tuning plus
small garment offsets did not produce the required integrated forms.

## What actually happened

The330 brief and new331 strategy were read, a fresh domain knowledge packet was
created for each job, and local reviewed Blender handlers produced six phase
renders per variant. However, **the four controller stages were not submitted
before native construction**. The written stages were not equivalent to executing
the controller. This is an adoption/admission failure, not successful prospective
qualification of330. The later controller record is explicitly retrospective
frozen-evidence review; it cannot repair that chronology or demonstrate independent
reviewer judgment. No separate runtime/model calls were made.

The controller currently supports offline and frozen-evidence modes only. It does
not own this Blender launcher or enforce the ordered pose/look prerequisites on
native jobs. A native-authoring bridge remains unqualified. The agent could still
have applied the stage API before diagnostic work and did not; the software limit
does not excuse that omission.

| Trial | Actual result | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| pose01 | New whole-pose controls exposed excessive hindquarter lowering and outward/upward forehoof orientation at the crest. | FAIL; initial attempt retained. |
| pose02 | Forehooves improved, but support legs became too straight; cloth calculation emitted an invalid-power warning, sash became buried, and beard edit targeted a hidden contributor. | FAIL; first correction retained. Process finished before attempted cancellation. |
| pose03 | Finite cloth calculation, visible beard targeting and sash support corrected. Crest has more head flex and unequal forelegs; landing lowers head/torso more. Gather/drive still lack the reference's compact coordinated shape; broad costume and coat remain schematic. | FAIL; second correction retained. No claim of full-speed motion quality. |

Native outputs are under `.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh331/pose-01` through
`pose-03`. Inspected source frames298,314,327,344,350,353 are diagnostic samples,
not adequate continuous motion/contact coverage. Reference authority is the
14–19s passage of reference-b.mov, with preserved321 phase comparisons. Camera
projection and horse conformation differ; exact screen-space matching is not the
criterion. Gather, articulated support, active balance and distributed absorption
are the criterion.

## Concrete remaining failures

- **P1 preparation:** frame298 still reads as a long-necked standing horse with
  small offsets, rather than the reference's gathered neck/poll/chest/quarter shape.
- **P2 drive/crest:** forehoof orientation is better at327, but the lower support
  remains comparatively extended and the forelimb folds abrupt. Changing head
  pitch did not establish a coherent spine/neck/support shape family. Full reverse
  support and visible hoof-contact proofs were not completed.
- **P3 contact/recovery:**350/353 show more compression. That alone does not qualify
  reaching transitions, absorption timing or rider/seat/stirrup/rein interfaces.
  Old dependent caches were not all rebuilt; this is NOT_RUN, not pending approval.
- **P4 appearance:** intended-size frames retain a cap-like crown, shell-like
  torso, narrow regular beard, tubular lower clothing and a polished horse coat.
  The rounded saddle pad is less slab-like, but its spine support is unproven.
  This fails the accepted film floor without requiring a full-speed AV judgment.
- **P5 crowd:** not propagated or newly qualified because the representative
  actor prerequisite failed. Existing320 crowd remains rejected.
- **P6 continuity:** only sampled phase frames, not the contiguous252–441 passage.
  Reverse controls, fresh-open render comparison and sound synchronization NOT_RUN.
- **P7 process:** late controller use, incomplete early recipe snapshots and
  inherited transitive handlers not all pinned in the job input list. pose03 has
  source snapshots for its listed code; pose01/02 do not. Do not claim exact replay
  recipes or a validated authoring bridge for these trials.

## Correction accounting and stopping

The331 strategy inherited a two-correction package allowance. Its wording that
early diagnostics are not external reviews must not become an unlimited retry
loophole: these were three corrective variants of the same construction hypothesis.
Count them as initial attempt plus two corrections. The retrospective frozen
review records those three actual variants; it does not grant three more attempts.
The native launcher is closed for this package. No elapsed-time limit is the
reason for stopping. No knowingly failed candidate is sent for artistic review.

## Consequence and recommendation

Do not scale these forms into a crowd, add more random movement, or render the
whole passage. Preserve the visual goal and accepted Pashtun floor.

Recommended next package: qualify a **local native-authoring admission path**,
then perform a representation-level proof rather than another offset pass. The
bridge must bind original sources/stage receipts, allow only scoped native handlers,
own the single-job lease and shared correction counter, stop dependent work after
a failed pose/look prerequisite, and feed actual candidate bytes into fresh review.
Use the current chat for reasoning; no paid runtime calls, new models or cloud are
needed merely to implement that boundary. This is a proposed scope change from
the failed native proof, not a feature claimed implemented here.

The subsequent construction must solve hind support, pelvis/chest/neck/poll and
rider contact as one pose family; rebuilding the visible garment/tack forms is
separate from microtexture. Exit: reference-comparable gather/crest/contact poses
and one same-film supporting actor at intended framing, with reverse/contact and
transition evidence, before crowd propagation or the integrated sequence.

Remaining alternatives are to continue manual main-chat authoring with a clearly
declared weaker enforcement boundary, or to qualify the bridge first. The latter
is recommended because this proof repeated the exact execution-versus-procedure
gap that the Director asked330 to address. No change of creative quality, paid
asset purchase or specialist is proposed.

## Measurement limits

Three native pose candidates, eighteen phase renders, zero accepted media outputs,
zero Director artistic-review requests. There is one method/scope escalation at
closure. Native job durations are measured separately in the operating ledger;
initial context recovery predates capture. No percentage efficiency improvement,
avoided Director-input count, complete token usage or backup qualification is
claimed. Local commits do not protect native outputs off this SSD.

061c85a4dc4f3d739c5f9292edc400b6962980ec.text:
# Shot / beat performance and believability brief

Adopted operating requirement at Director exchange249, 2026-10-13. Extends the existing audience brief, motion brief and production strategy; not another Director approval form or a new production department. Applies to every planned shot and its materially distinct beats. Group shared requirements once, then record beat-specific differences. A static insert can have a short brief with justified not-applicable lenses.

## Responsibility: expertise lenses, one integrated result

The executing agent owns a shot-supervision function: reason from the intended audience experience, apply the relevant expertise, resolve conflicting requirements and verify the whole result. Do not wait for the Director to identify technical failures. The Director supplies intent, material creative choices and acceptance, not joint-placement, simulation or deformation diagnoses.

Apply these lenses to the same versioned shot artifact, not a mandatory chain of agents:

- **Story, performance and audience:** what changes for viewers, character intention, recognizable identity, emotional legibility, attention and larger-than-life signature moment.
- **Animation and physical action:** support, balance, effort, momentum, coordinated joints, weight transfer, impact and recovery. Skilled control is not rigid stillness.
- **Anatomy, rigging and contact:** articulation pivots, deforming volume, skin/cloth boundaries, fingers and grip, feet/props/partners, reach and contact ownership.
- **Character effects and environmental response:** hair, mane, tail, cloth, straps, dust/debris; supports, lag, inertia, gravity, forcing and collisions must tell a compatible physical story.
- **Camera, look and editorial:** what the framing actually exposes, continuity and causal geography, silhouette, palette/lighting/material readability, pace and exposure duration.
- **Sound and music:** weight and synchronization, intelligibility, musical preparation/payoff and which element owns attention. Direct listening and signal checks are separate evidence.
- **Production/reuse/rights:** viable representation, dependencies, revision needs, accepted-source limits, resource and rights boundaries.

These are review perspectives, not claimed human specialist qualifications or independent model judgments. A single agent can miss things across all of them. Where knowledge is weak, identify it, research a relevant primary reference or run a discriminating control; do not fill the gap with confident prose.

## Brief fields — complete before substantial execution

Keep the filled brief in the existing sequence work package, linking this template. Bind its revision in the task packet alongside actual source inputs.

1. **Identity and authority:** sequence/shot/beat IDs and timing; accepted creative/source versions; what is fixed, flexible or undecided. Keep Shot Intent separate from the changeable realization plan.
2. **Audience result:** what viewers should understand, feel and notice; extraordinary moment and contrast; what must remain recognizable. State hypotheses, not invented audience research.
3. **Visibility and criticality:** actual framing, screen size, exposure and action; required quality-floor behaviors, dramatic priorities and optional refinements. An out-of-frame assumption needs evidence and a reopening trigger. Low salience cannot excuse a visible structural failure.
4. **Applicable lenses and predicted failures:** actively scan the lenses above. Explain omissions. Include likely unreported distractions and adjacent interfaces, not only the current Director defect list.
5. **Strategy per important behavior:** intended motion/deformation/response; chosen representation and why it fits; owner and coordinate space of contacts; inputs/supports, coupled dependencies and known limitations. Choose authored animation, constrained procedural motion, simulation or a declared hybrid on evidence, not prestige. Specify which matters must be physically consistent and which may be intentionally heightened without contradiction.
6. **Earliest representative proof:** cheap actual-framing motion plus revealing controls before polish/full rendering. Define observable pass/fail, a negative control, required references and what outcome changes the method. Numbers support visual/audio judgment, not replace it.
7. **Review, revision and exit:** evidence per requirement; changed-input invalidation; uncertainty; remaining optional work and reopening triggers; release dependency unlocked. Use the integrated internal gate, not a new handoff at every lens.

Use this row format for the important behaviors; a generic list of body parts is insufficient:

| Beat / audience-visible requirement | Lens; predicted distraction and importance | Method, owner and interfaces | Early proof / explicit failure condition | Evidence, status and reopening trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# Frozen next-production brief — Nihang, horse and near crowd

Frozen before new construction at330. This is the prospective creative/technical
work package, **not an executed native job, admission receipt or a new live-model
allowance**. It uses known321 failures deliberately; the prospective question is
whether application prevents their recurrence and finds adjacent problems.
Before native dispatch create the fresh motion/look task packet and bind its
current sources and exact native derivative. The workflow330 knowledge-only
packet must not be reused as a production-motion packet.

## Grounding and authority

- Director intent: a commanding mounted Nihang acknowledges the Sikh with a
  spear cue and powerful rearing. The watching crowd parts purposefully while
  retaining attention on the rider. People are supporting cast, not silhouettes
  and not schematic statues. Same-film credibility is near the Pashtun, without
  requiring the principal's portrait-specific detail or recurrence investment.
- Reference-b.mov, recorded in `results/sikh321/evidence.json` and321 audit, is
  **faithful action/whole-pose authority**, approximately14–19s; it is not a
  source of identity, scenery or measured physical forces. Its edited monocular
  view does not uniquely specify unseen3D anatomy. Use support/anatomy plausibility
  to resolve unseen structure; document inference rather than copy screen pixels.
- Accepted253 Pashtun remains the production appearance/finish comparator and
  protected unchanged master;152 accepted head deviations remain accepted.321's
  candidate320/10 is a negative control, never the next quality floor.
- Applicable lessons:321 method/judgment/admission audit;271 same-film foundation
  failure;249 beat believability brief;250 avoidable-input audit;317 reuse before
  custom construction;328 expert derivation;330 source-bound planning. Reconcile
  exact AU/obligation IDs in the production task packet, not a generic assertion
  that retrieval “covered everything.”
- Director preferences: larger-than-life, weighty, fluid, dramatic; preserve
  believable support and force. Efficient Quality means improving the efficiency
  of reaching that bar, not lowering it. No routine method approvals.
- Scope: leader/rearing then crowd, one second before/after for continuity. Exclude
  Sikh principal replacement, whole-trailer rerender, Pashtun changes, new paid
  providers/assets, Gurkha, and unrelated terrain polish. Use the existing bounded
  correction policy; no per-substep reset or arbitrary elapsed-time handoff.

## Derived requirements and expert application

| Beat / requirement | Applied lenses and why | Proof / failure condition |
|---|---|---|
| Preparation: spear cue gathers horse and rider | Choreography, animal anatomy, support/contact, performance. Intent must cause loading, not detached forefoot shuffle. | Compare complete supported silhouette: hock/stifle flex, pelvis/chest relation, forefoot placement, neck arch and poll, seat/hand response. Fail if gestures move but overall animal remains an upright column. |
| Drive and crest: powerful active balance | Animation/physics, anatomy, rider performance, camera. Preserve curved articulated forelegs, unequal presentation and yielding neck without floating hind support. | Whole-pose and transition interiors from actual camera plus revealing side/rear; supported leg constraints must allow reference-like shape family. Fail if global body pivot and straight hind legs do all the work, or pose merely pauses rigidly. |
| Reach, impact and recovery: heavy, fluid landing | Animation/contact, effects, sound. Reaching legs, descending mass and absorption must agree; particles/audio cannot fake absent body weight. | Phase map, timed-frame body/hoof/head trajectories, contact/compression/recovery frames. Fail if toes arrive quickly but chest/head/rider snap to standing with no absorption, or airborne settling slows before impact. Full-speed feel/listening remain Director AV. |
| Commanding human and credible horse/tack | Look, costume construction, cultural specificity, anatomy, lighting, reuse. Larger-than-life comes from forms/material hierarchy and attitude, not a smooth shell plus fibers. | Leader/horse/saddle at standing, crest and landing at actual review size beside accepted production evidence. Reject cap-like turban, pointed regular beard, tube sleeves/trousers, slab saddle cloth, sculptural coat or washed-out face. Separate clay from matched material/light control. |
| Crowd opens the way while watching | Staging, social performance, gait/contact, camera. Attention persists while shoulders/hips/feet can orient differently; movement has motivation and stagger. | Prove one near warrior and a small representative interaction before propagation. Fail if everyone side-steps synchronously, faces away, keeps torsos locked frontally, slides feet or wears identical rigid garment shells. |
| Exchange and continuity | Cinematography/editorial, performance. Leader's gaze/body action and rider position must read as one exchange. | Preserve line of action and existing accepted staging; actual shot camera and one-second handles, not only flattering diagnostics. Check spear/torch/tack/feet/ground interfaces and who sees whom. |

Each row inherits production look, protected-source constraints, reference roles
and agent-versus-Director review ownership above. Sound is not omitted: retain
spear, hoof impact, neigh and ground-response event anchors and existing authority;
final listening judgment is not fabricated from waveforms. No new score choice.

## Integrated method and earliest proof

1. Build a phase/pose map from321's preserved samples and source. Record gather,
   drive, active crest, reach/contact and compression/recovery, including intentional
   breakdown poses and coupled horse/rider landmarks. No native mutation yet.
2. On a reversible derivative test the existing rig against that full pose family.
   Explicitly isolate whether hind-support constraints/global pivot prevent hock
   bend or absorption. Reauthor supported poses; change the constraint/representation
   only if the control demonstrates the blocker. **Do not start with retiming,
   random secondary sway, more keyframes or fibers.** These preserved the failed
   shape trajectory before. Alternatives are targeted rig correction versus
   scoped reconstruction; choose using this control, not sunk effort.
3. Before expensive finishing, prove one leader + actual horse/saddle/tack at
   intended framing and one near crowd actor. Reuse qualified construction methods
   where applicable, not an automatic transfer of identity or quality. Fix broad
   form/drape/support before microtexture. Motion proof and look proof are separate
   vetoes and must both survive integration.
4. Author the short continuous action with overlap, contact and recovery. Add
   cloth/groom/earth response driven by common events; verify debris persists in
   world space rather than disappearing. Test transition interiors and adjacent
   spear/rein/seat/stirrup contacts. No hero render before representative proof.
5. Propagate only the qualified crowd construction with differentiated starts,
   gait/stance, head/torso response and constrained attention. Render only the
   agreed isolated two-shot sequence plus handles; then perform frozen review.

## Challenge and exit

Strongest counterexample: a complete plan can again produce an elegant mechanical
horse and schematic people. Pose names, nonzero keyframes, matching duration,
attached clothes and test counts would not falsify that. Require explicit
reference-versus-candidate observations of whole shape, weight response and
same-film form at intended size. If this proof fails, route back to strategy or
representation, not another cosmetic retime.

Internal exit: no known frame/source-visible failures; actual source-bound
appearance, pose/contact, continuity and technical evidence; explicit adjacent
regression checks. Direct motion/audio/overall effect remain accurately labeled
pending Director AV, not used as an excuse to queue visible failures. The Director
receives one isolated reviewable sequence, not rig algorithms or intermediate
diagnostics. A true authority/method blocker must provide evidence, viable
alternatives and one recommendation.

## Prospective measurement

Before construction assign defect IDs to the six requirement rows. Capture planned
proofs, active work intervals, render job intervals and exact candidate hashes.
After review classify new feedback: useful creative refinement versus avoidable
requirement/retrieval/method/evidence/judgment/admission failure. Record regressions,
internal catches, external escapes and handoff reasons. Do not retrospectively
rewrite these predictions to match results. Compare like-for-like scope; no
promised percentage improvement and no need to perfect invisible details.

# Native workflow ready for the next Nihang work package

The router-first workflow now has a real, locally exercised path from admitted
planning to numeric Blender authoring, saved derivative, fresh-process render
and output rejection. This qualifies the **supported main-chat workflow and
typed operations**, not an autonomous studio, a healthy horse rig, or better
artistic judgment. No separate-runtime call allowance was renewed.

## Entry and sequencing

1. Record the actual request and all effects in the canonical router. Use
   continuation for an unfinished package; do not rename a failed artistic task.
2. Ground original direction, accepted and rejected controls, reference roles,
   applicable lessons, film language and Director preferences. Derive concrete
   requirements with expert lenses; freeze a strategy and challenge it before
   dispatch. Preserve the330/328 stage contracts and fresh source-bound packets.
3. Bind each typed recipe to a strategy step and source binding. `native_inspect`
   is required; rendering additionally requires `render`, authoring requires
   `edit`. The bridge owns the single heavy-job lease and reserves attempts
   before launch. No raw legacy Blender fallback or arbitrary Python payload.
4. Inspect actual returned evidence before recording a prerequisite PASS.
   Successful exit is insufficient. A dependent render must open the reviewed
   derivative in a fresh process; selected rig/camera and authored mesh/material
   state must match. Changed inputs, recipes, dependencies or handlers invalidate
   admission. New operation types require reviewed handlers/tests, not code strings.
5. Freeze and review against original intent and references, including omissions
   and adjacent failures. A rejected prerequisite blocks successors. Direct
   audiovisual judgment remains the Director's313 queue; frame-visible failures
   cannot be hidden behind that pending human judgment.

## Qualified operation envelope

`nihang_save` and `nihang_render` preserve selected native state and render a
bounded source-camera frame. `nihang_patch` accepts validated horse-rig quaternion
keys and bounded new mesh geometry with base-color/roughness values. All changes
are to disposable derivatives. Target names and exact recipes are frozen in the
plan; source masters are never overwritten. The actual test wrote an absolute
one-degree local head-control key and an off-camera triangle, not a one-degree
delta or a proposed improvement to the horse. Both persisted in a fresh process.

This is sufficient to start the next pose/representation proof through the
controlled path. It is not a claim that every future rig, garment, constraint,
simulation or animation operation is implemented. Adding a needed trusted
handler is routine in-scope engineering, with its own early control, not a reason
to bypass the workflow or ask the Director to choose an algorithm.

## Technical recovery without artistic reset

`recover_native_control` retains the same task, deliverable, original authority,
failed runs and artistic counters. It requires a source-bound continuation,
terminated failed fixed-control attempt, no active job or artistic candidate/
rejection, and fresh grounding through challenge. Its separate ceiling is three
technical recoveries per task, not per renamed run or plan. This334 safeguard is
an implementation bound, **not a new Director-wide artistic policy**. Planning
implementation repair before any recovered plan/worker exists also preserves
the recovery count. Interrupted reservations are not auto-replayed.

333's failed attempt and334's two further diagnostic failures remain intact;
the third recovery completed save/reopen. The later numeric-authoring transport
test was a separately scoped implementation control, not another recovery or331
artistic trial. Closed331 and exhausted325 remain closed.

## Findings that must affect the Nihang method

`rig_ui.py` being skipped was not proof of broken evaluation. Embedded code stayed
disabled and was inspected only as data. The diagnostic also found **64 invalid
non-executable SUM drivers with missing targets on the used horse armature**.
They are not orphan data. Historical300 explicitly bypassed some removed Rigify
controls; generic rig health was never established.

The exact diagnosed legacy-defect digest is permitted only to reproduce the
unchanged rejected negative control. Unknown invalid or unsafe Python drivers
block. A rendered output carrying those known defects cannot receive PASS.
Do not transfer that exemption into a production quality claim. The next pose
proof must explicitly establish ownership and evaluation of the controls it
uses, and repair/rebuild or exclude broken dependencies with evidence before
qualifying motion. No blind generic-driver restoration.

## Next production package and exit

Use [the frozen Nihang brief](../../results/workflow330/NIHANG_PROSPECTIVE_BRIEF.md)
and [331 failure analysis](../../results/sikh331/PROOF_AUDIT.md). Start with
representation and control ownership, not another root-pivot/angle offset pass.
Prove coupled gather, drive/crest, reach/contact and absorption poses with horse,
rider, seat, reins and support; bind the14–19s reference passage as faithful action
authority. Use intended camera plus revealing side/rear contact checks.

Separately prove one supporting leader and one near crowd actor against the
accepted Pashtun's film language before replication. Require credible clothing,
face, turban and tack forms; crowd attention stays on the rider while whole bodies
move with motivated stagger. Then integrate only the isolated leader/rearing and
crowd passage with one-second handles. No Pashtun rerender or new music decision.

Exit is no known frame/source-visible failures and evidence-backed pose/look/
interface checks, followed by one Director audiovisual review—not another set
of incremental failed diagnostics. Bind the new package's actual authorized
correction scope; do not silently resurrect331. Record prospective internal
catches, escaped defects, useful creative choices, handoffs and work/render time.

## What the evidence does and does not prove

Real local saves, independent reopens, two inspected diagnostic renders, exact
selected-state matches and blocked successors establish the scoped technical
path.428 focused regressions pass. Known wrong-method semantic controls remain:
a well-formed but bad plan can still fool a permissive reviewer. No measured
reduction in Director interventions, token savings, universal memory, complete
dependency portability or independent perceptual accuracy is claimed.

The router cannot intercept every raw chat tool at OS level. Main-chat reasoning
and review remain fallible; the separate multi-model runtime has not received a
new allowance or fresh live six-stage qualification. Local records/commits are
not a new remote backup. See [qualification evidence](../../results/workflow334/CLOSEOUT.md).

brief.intent: Determine actual horse control and deformation ownership before representation-level correction, without mutating media.

anatomy.reason: Read rest joint lengths and evaluated chain before diagnosing deformation; later separate anatomical pose from shader and lighting problems.

animal_coordination.reason: Trace hind support, chest, poll, forefeet and rider contact together; reference phases govern, not number of keys.

anticipation.reason: Predict unsupported hind legs, straight neck, rigid rider and slow contact before editing; include phase interiors and reverse views in the next proof.

au_contact.reason: Endpoint contact does not prove anatomical pose; inspect actual hoof/joint axes and rider hand/seat chains, retaining known-bad controls.

au_deformation.reason: Test control ownership and deformation separately from material/light; never hide unsupported anatomy with costume.

au_performance.reason: Reference-like loading, forcing and recovery require coupled torso/neck and support; still inventory cannot certify continuous motion.

au_reuse.reason: Record exact tested-use limits and native jobs; do not call local artifacts a remote backup or whole-scene portable bundle.

au_surface.reason: Subsequent look proof compares matched lighting and scale with accepted film; no flat color or noise substitute for designed forms.

authority.reason: Resume authorized local production; no spend, installation, cloud, external calls, identity changes or higher-model assumptions.

cache_safety.reason: One owned worker, disabled embedded scripts, credential-free job and no source/cache overwrite; future motion invalidates dependent caches.

construction_interfaces.reason: Inspect bone local/rest/world transforms and visible endpoint ownership before adapting; later prove one clothed actor and partial poses before crowd copies.

crowd_support.reason: Retain rider attention and coordinated supported stepping in the integrated package; no crowd mutation in the ownership precursor.

current_state.reason: 253 provisional Pashtun stays protected;335 resumes isolated leader/crowd, not Sikh identity or full trailer. Director313 retains AV judgment.

economics.reason: Record serial worker and active intervals inSIKH335; no invented savings, cost or denominator from old sequence effort.

look.reason: Keep same-film Pashtun richness as fixed floor for leader and near crowd; source320 schematic costumes are negative controls.

motion.reason: Establish one owner per control and endpoint before keys; no nonzero-key or numeric-distance claim of natural performance.

render_profile.reason: Read-only precursor does not render; later measure actual source/profile and retain CPU fallback without assuming previous Metal qualification transfers.

reuse_envelope.reason: Existing horse is an unqualified adaptation source, not a qualified rearing asset; diagnose its actual reuse envelope before reconstruction.

secondary.reason: Changed primary motion reopens mane, tail, reins, cloth and earth response; defer these until the primary representation works, not waive them.

sikh_motion.reason: Rearing and crowd have their own support proof; keep causal exchange and corridor clearance in integrated isolated output. No reuse of gallop qualification as rear proof.

sikh_scope.reason: Sikh sequence only, nonrecurring leader recognizes rider, no new story or music mapping in this correction.

stopping.reason: No technical setup handover; continue toward integrated isolated clip unless a genuine material blocker requires the Director.

strategy.reason: Ownership inspection discriminates repair versus rebuild before authored poses;331 root-offset failures remain closed and inform the method change.

versioning.reason: Bind parent, handler, recipe and dependencies; preserve original320,331 failure evidence and accepted Pashtun unchanged.

visual_gate.reason: Inventory success only qualifies completeness of evidence; rejected native art and unreviewed motion remain rejected or NOT_RUN.

reference_rear.application: Map faithful action phases to available controls; do not infer quality from technical success.

references.allowed_variation: Adapt to shot geography and existing horse proportions without robotic phase boundaries.

aspects.instruction: Discover controls that can reproduce whole-body phases rather than root rotation alone.

references.authority: Director requires faithful rearing, not a simplified approximation.
references.fidelity: Coordinated gather, driving hindquarters, brief crest, accelerating reach/contact and absorption.
references.not_authority: Not a new identity, wardrobe license or exemption from same-film quality.
references.scope: 14–19 seconds; source inventory is preparatory and does not qualify performance.

requirements.criterion: Source masters remain unchanged; no pose or appearance edits during diagnosis.

A successful inventory is not a healthy rig, faithful rearing, same-film look or Director AV pass.

brief.strategy: Read-only ownership inspection before deciding targeted repair or deformation rebuild.

method_choice.alternatives: Reject another guessed root-pivot pass; do not restore all drivers or rebuild before knowing ownership.
method_choice.chosen: Fixed read-only control/constraint/driver/deformation inventory on the rejected parent.
method_choice.discriminating_test: Determine whether invalid drivers drive deformation or merely UI, and whether actual pose controls reach deform bones.

STRATEGIZING.replan_triggers: Missing ownership evidence or unsafe unknown driver blocks; diagnostic findings determine next representation plan, not a Director algorithm approval.
STRATEGIZING.resource_scope: One local read-only worker,600s safety timeout, no external calls or assets.

steps.acceptance: Complete parseable actual ownership evidence, unchanged parent; artistic status remains rejected.

planning_feedback: Correct reference role enum to faithful_motion as already required by the Director; no scope or authority change.
expert_instruction: Fresh planning challenge, not production acceptance. Compare original direction, sources and reference roles with derivation and strategy.
